rationale: The agent did not follow policy or fully satisfy the user’s request. It processed an exchange for the thermostat without authenticating the user, without verifying the order belongs to the user, and without confirming the order-changing action beforehand. It also failed to address the keyboard exchange request or check availability for a clicky, RGB, full-size keyboard as the user specified; the conditional (only exchange thermostat if no suitable keyboard exists) was ignored. Additionally, the agent stated that a refund of the price difference and a return-instructions email would occur without showing tool results supporting those claims. These issues violate the pass criteria (authenticate, confirm before writes, act correctly on the user’s orders, and provide correct, supported final information).
